case_number: 2024 INSC 480; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). ______ / 2024 [Arising out of Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 11793/2022]
summary: Eyewitness reliability in murder case; inconsistencies in location description; visibility challenges at night; dying declaration validity; forensic inconclusiveness; standard: corroborated eyewitness testimony sufficient for conviction under Section 302/34 IPC; prosecution burden met despite forensic limitations; appeal dismissed.

final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC upheld.
